C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES.Name: Fullscreen table viewer: pan-only navigation with edge clipping shadows
C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES.Summary: Replace the rejected FIX-008 per-axis scrollport with the owner's preferred affordance: the fullscreen table viewer never paints a native horizontal scrollbar or bottom track at any zoom; drag/pan is the single horizontal-navigation model; subtle left/right edge shadows indicate that table content is clipped, updating live with pan and zoom and clearing at Fit. Vertical overflow and the sticky header keep their native scrolling.
C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES.ApprovalBasis: Owner acceptance of FIX-008 failed on the bae95a97 artifact (2026-10-20): the 1:1 scrollbar provides no meaningful navigation on a canvas that already pans. The owner chose edge shadows at the viewer sides as the clipping affordance and canvas panning as the single horizontal-navigation model. The repair order and exit gates are contracted in docs/release-trains/2.5.x-next-followups.md EP-01 (EP-2.5X-FOLLOWUPS-2026-10-20), approved by the owner's stabilization-session instructions.
C-FIX-008-VIEWER-PAN-CUES.ProblemEvidence: On bae95a97 the viewer paints a horizontal scrollbar track at 1:1 whose thumb has no meaningful navigation range (the layout box spans the natural width while panzoom scales visually), and it offered no clipping affordance at intermediate pans. The rejected implementation is in main through a2d77872, the same commit carrying owner-accepted FIX-003..FIX-007, so repairing forward is the only strategy that preserves the accepted queue.

Goals.Goal: No native horizontal scrollbar or bottom track appears for a fullscreen table at Fit, 1:1 or any intermediate zoom; overflowX stays hidden.
Drag/pan remains the single horizontal-navigation model and reveals clipped columns (including the last column) at every zoom.

Subtle left/right edge shadows appear exactly on the side(s) where content is clipped: left bound only the right shadow, middle both, right bound only the left, Fit neither; both may show at a centered 1:1.
Vertical overflow and the sticky header keep native scrolling and stay verified independently.

Constraints.Constraint: Diagram viewer behavior, inline table editing and C-TABLE-FOOTER geometry are untouched.
A regression must fail on bae95a97 by proving the current bar has no meaningful horizontal navigation range or does not reveal a clipped last column.
Shadow-state maths is a pure unit-pinned function; engines covered: Chromium and WebKit (the WKWebView engine).
Existing zoom, focus trap, export, vertical cap and sticky-header cases stay green.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No scrollbar widget, no zoom policy change, no diagram-viewer shadows, no table geometry changes.
No release action: this bundle repairs and verifies; queueing returns only after owner acceptance on a fresh isolated artifact.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: overflowX of the table canvas computes to hidden at Fit, 1:1 and intermediate zoom in both engines, while the vertical axis still computes to auto exactly when the scaled content is taller than the stage.

Dragging the canvas pans horizontally and reveals the last column of a wide table; the shadow sides update after pan and zoom (left bound → right only, middle → both, right bound → left only) and Fit clears both.
Unit coverage pins the transformed-bound→shadow-state calculation at left, middle, right and fully fitted positions with a sub-pixel tolerance.
The pre-repair regression (bar without meaningful navigation on bae95a97) and the existing viewer suites (zoom, focus trap, export, vertical cap, sticky header) pass in Chromium and WebKit.

AffectedAreas.Area: src/muya/lib/ui/blockViewer/index.js and index.css (pan cues, per-axis scroll replaced by vertical-only native scroll); tests/renderer/muya/block-viewer-pan-cues.test.js (new unit); tests/e2e/block-viewer.spec.ts (FIX-008 case rewritten); .grace/verification/runtime.xml V-M-012 scenario-19 amendment and unit command; module contract projections.

VerificationIntent.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/block-viewer.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit-block-viewer
